note: RTT-103 company logos (IQ-18, design round 1). Purpose: identification of each company on its bar only (as RTT-001, DEC-180/DEC-182; house style section 7). Files live ONLY in the private repo (assets/rtt-103/logos/), fetched on a GitHub runner by .github/workflows/rtt103_assets.yml with scripts/rtt103_fetch_logos.py, because Wikimedia answers HTTP 429 to the Claude Code container (8 Oct 2026). For each company the runner takes the first candidate title that exists on Commons (else the first search hit whose title contains 'logo'), records the file page, licence, author, restrictions and SHA-1 from the Commons API, and keeps the file only if the downloaded SHA-1 equals the API's. Hashes are then copied into `fetched` below and into assets_sha256.txt; every render checks them. Never redrawn or recoloured; crops only where Luke allows.
